verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents an open-source benchmarking tool for measuring deployment performance and markets 'Fast' variants and 'better performance/lower latency' claims, which functions as a load-testing guide, but the evidence pack contains no actual published tokens-per-second or latency numbers, nor third-party/independent benchmark results validating the speed claims. Missing for 10: concrete published TPS/latency figures, third-party or independent benchmark corroboration, and detailed load-testing methodology beyond a tool pointer.
